subject: Trading
title: Trading Plans
description: A quick win: understand Trading Plans.

hook.text: No general enters battle without a plan. No pilot flies without a checklist. Why do traders trade without either?

buildup.text: A trading plan defines what you trade, when you enter, where you exit, and how much you risk—before emotions arrive.

discovery.text: The plan is made when you're calm and rational. It's followed when you're stressed and emotional.

twist.text: Most traders write a plan but abandon it after two losses. The plan works over hundreds of trades, not two.

climax.text: A mediocre plan followed consistently beats a brilliant plan followed randomly. Consistency is the edge.

punchline.text: The plan is the discipline. Follow it.

quiz.question: Why is a trading plan important?
options: It removes emotional decision-making during stressful moments
